_README: EXTERNAL GROUND-TRUTH ANCHORS — copy this file to external_anchors.json and fill in.
WHY THIS EXISTS: our simulation ground truth is model-in-the-loop — the same
GNN both produces the predictions evaluators see AND scores which intervention
is best. That is internally consistent but circular by construction. To break
the circle at a few points, ask a domain expert (e.g. the UNCC professor) to
identify 1-2 scenarios where they KNOW the real-world correct intervention from
professional experience. Those become out-of-model ground truth. analyze.py then
ALSO reports accuracy scored against these anchors, per condition.
HOW TO FILL: one entry per anchored scenario. Key = scenario_id (see
scenarios.json). `intervention` MUST be one of the candidate action names:
`source` and `rationale` are for the paper's audit trail (who said so, and why).
Delete this _README key in the real file, or leave it — the loader ignores it.
